title: Table-Critic: A Multi-Agent Framework for Collaborative Criticism and Refinement in Table Reasoning
problem: Intermediate table-reasoning errors propagate because existing decomposition methods lack reliable criticism and correction.
assumption_broken: Critique knowledge need not remain fixed inside the model but can accumulate in an evolving template tree.
load_bearing_mechanism: A curator organizes successful critique patterns into a self-evolving tree that guides subsequent error-specific criticism.

improver_modified.how: Accumulated critique templates change the guidance used by future critics.

limitations_evident: Evaluation limited to textual tables
Judge errors can terminate refinement prematurely
Refinement is iteration capped

title: A-MEM: Agentic Memory for LLM Agents
problem: Static memory schemas and operations prevent agents from organizing and adapting long-term conversational knowledge.
assumption_broken: Historical memory representations and their connections need not remain fixed after storage.
load_bearing_mechanism: New notes trigger semantic links and contextual updates to related historical notes.
limitations_evident: Memory organization depends on underlying LLM quality
Only textual interactions evaluated
Retrieval settings vary by question category

title: MobileSteward: Integrating Multiple App-Oriented Agents with Self-Evolution to Automate Cross-App Instructions
problem: Cross-app mobile tasks fail because of scheduling dependencies, heterogeneous apps, and error propagation.
assumption_broken: App expertise and execution guidelines can evolve from successful interactions rather than remaining static.
load_bearing_mechanism: Successful app executions update expertise and task-guideline memories used for subsequent scheduling and action planning.
limitations_evident: Memories continue updating during test evaluation
Android emulator evaluation
Execution limited by retry and step caps

title: LADDER: Self-Improving LLMs Through Recursive Problem Decomposition
problem: Direct reinforcement learning on difficult integration problems yields almost no positive rewards and can collapse.
assumption_broken: A useful difficulty curriculum need not be human curated because models can generate recursively simpler problem variants.
load_bearing_mechanism: Recursive variant trees supply solvable stepping stones for verifiable-reward reinforcement learning.
limitations_evident: Numerical verifier can be inaccurate
Generated variants can be harder than their parents
Test-time training targets failed benchmark questions

title: MAS-GPT: Training LLMs to Build LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems
problem: Building query-adaptive multi-agent systems requires manual design or expensive repeated model calls.
assumption_broken: Multi-agent system construction can be learned as single-pass code generation instead of repeated online search.
load_bearing_mechanism: Consistency-oriented selection and refinement of successful query-system pairs trains a generalizable system generator.

improver_modified.how: Supervised fine-tuning trains the model that proposes query-specific multi-agent systems.

limitations_evident: Training relies on a manually constructed base system pool
Inference cost uses model-size-weighted call counts
Dataset construction evaluates many query-system combinations

title: In Prospect and Retrospect: Reflective Memory Management for Long-term Personalized Dialogue Agents
problem: Rigid memory granularity and fixed retrieval limit long-term personalized dialogue.
assumption_broken: Retrieval can adapt online without labeled relevance data by using the generator's memory citations as feedback.
load_bearing_mechanism: Citation-derived binary rewards train a lightweight memory reranker while topic-based summaries consolidate conversation history.
limitations_evident: Online reinforcement learning adds computational expense
Text-only dialogue evaluation
Privacy-preserving deployment remains future work

title: Advanced Tool Learning and Selection System (ATLASS): A Closed-Loop Framework Using LLM
problem: Predefined toolsets cannot satisfy novel tasks requiring packages or external APIs.
assumption_broken: An agent's tool inventory can grow through on-demand generation rather than being fixed by experts.
load_bearing_mechanism: Execution-checked tool generation with environment setup and API documentation populates a reusable tool database.
limitations_evident: Tested with one GPT-4 model
Complex API tools remain difficult
Quantitative comparative tool-generation evaluation deferred

title: MDTeamGPT: A Self-Evolving LLM-based Multi-Agent Framework for Multi-Disciplinary Team Medical Consultation
problem: Long multi-specialist discussions increase cognitive load while unprocessed consultation histories fail to yield reusable reasoning experience.
assumption_broken: Both correct and incorrect consultations can become transferable guidance rather than merely stored transcripts.
load_bearing_mechanism: Separate knowledge bases retain verified successful consultations and corrected error reflections for retrieval in future discussions.
limitations_evident: Only two medical QA datasets evaluated
No real-world clinical validation
Experience quality depends on the backbone model

title: PLAY2PROMPT: Zero-shot Tool Instruction Optimization for LLM Agents via Tool Play
problem: New tools arrive with inadequate documentation and no labeled usage examples.
assumption_broken: Tool documentation can be optimized without labeled examples by deriving validation cases from actual tool interactions.
load_bearing_mechanism: Adversarially difficult execution-grounded examples become validation data for beam-search documentation refinement.
limitations_evident: Optimizes individual tools rather than joint dependencies
Rejection sampling struggles with large identifier spaces
Authentication-dependent tool calls may require prior tool outputs

title: MemInsight: Autonomous Memory Augmentation for LLM Agents
problem: Growing unstructured interaction histories make relevant memories difficult to retrieve.
assumption_broken: Memory attributes can be autonomously mined from content instead of relying solely on raw dialogue representations.
load_bearing_mechanism: LLM-generated attribute-value annotations structure memories and queries for attribute-filtered or embedding-based retrieval.
limitations_evident: Generic annotations can reduce retrieval specificity
Attribute quality depends on the generating model
Text-only implementation

title: Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Simulations for Realistic Clinical Interactions
problem: Static medical QA evaluations do not teach agents to gather missing clinical information through interactive diagnosis.
assumption_broken: Diagnostic strategies can improve through replaying successful cases and corrected failures without updating model weights.
load_bearing_mechanism: Retrieval from separate successful-case and corrected-error buffers supplies experience for future diagnostic consultations.
limitations_evident: Simulated cases are converted using GPT-4o
Experience-buffer and evaluation separation unspecified
Low accuracy on difficult image-based cases

title: DrunkAgent: Stealthy Memory Corruption in LLM-Powered Recommender Agents
problem: Dynamic recommender memories expose persistent poisoning vulnerabilities that static text attacks do not effectively exploit.
assumption_broken: Continually updated recommender memory is not inherently robust to natural-looking adversarial item descriptions.
load_bearing_mechanism: A surrogate recommender jointly optimizes semantic triggers and memory-corruption strategies for transferable item promotion.
limitations_evident: Stealthiness measured through perplexity and aggregate recommendation changes
Evaluation uses a single random seed
Threat model assumes editable target-item descriptions

title: Self-Evolving Visual Concept Library using Vision-Language Critics
problem: Static generated visual concepts lack discriminative power and neglect interactions that affect downstream classifiers.
assumption_broken: Visual concept vocabularies can evolve from unlabeled model-confusion feedback instead of being defined once.
load_bearing_mechanism: History-conditioned generation adds discriminative concepts for class pairs identified as confused by a vision-language critic.

improver_modified.how: Concept and feedback history conditions the generator's subsequent concept proposals.

limitations_evident: Few-shot results are mixed and can deteriorate
Depends on visual-backbone calibration
Limited to classification rather than complex visual reasoning

title: AgentNet: Decentralized Evolutionary Coordination for LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems
problem: Centralized multi-agent coordination creates bottlenecks and rigid roles that prevent adaptation and collaboration.
assumption_broken: Agent roles and communication topology can emerge from local experience instead of a fixed central orchestration plan.
load_bearing_mechanism: Local trajectory memories specialize routers and executors while success-weighted edge updates prune ineffective collaborations.
limitations_evident: Routing tested with relatively small predefined agent pools
Heterogeneity can reduce small-team performance
Large-scale agent discovery remains future work

title: Inducing Programmatic Skills for Agentic Tasks
problem: Textual skill memories lack executable verification and do not reduce low-level action planning burdens.
assumption_broken: Online agent skills can be executable action abstractions rather than free-form advice in memory.
load_bearing_mechanism: Programmatic skills enter the action space only after replay verifies task success, actual skill usage, and environment changes.
limitations_evident: Online evolution stability remains unexplored
Suitable skill granularity is unresolved
Website-specific skills may require adaptation

title: SkillWeaver: Web Agents can Self-Improve by Discovering and Honing Skills
problem: Web agents lack reusable procedural abstractions and repeatedly plan low-level website interactions.
assumption_broken: Useful web skills can be discovered through autonomous practice without test queries or annotated demonstrations.
load_bearing_mechanism: Autonomous exploration turns successful trajectories into tested composable Playwright APIs that expand the agent's action space.
limitations_evident: Exploration is performed separately for each website
Only accessible sufficiently represented live websites selected
Live exploration requires safeguards against harmful side effects

title: Dynamic Cheatsheet: Test-Time Learning with Adaptive Memory
problem: Stateless inference repeatedly rediscovers strategies and repeats mistakes across related queries.
assumption_broken: Black-box models can learn cumulatively at inference time without parameter updates or ground-truth feedback.
load_bearing_mechanism: A self-curated compact cheatsheet preserves reusable strategies and code while revising or pruning flawed entries.
limitations_evident: Faulty heuristics can accumulate and amplify errors
Weaker models may fail to curate useful memory
Full memory rewrites can truncate prior content

title: A Self-Improving Coding Agent
problem: Hand-designed agent scaffolds explore only a narrow range of useful coding tools and orchestration strategies.
assumption_broken: The agent that edits the scaffold can itself be selected from improved agents rather than remaining a fixed external meta-agent.
load_bearing_mechanism: The highest-utility archived coding agent edits its own implementation and competes under performance, time, and cost evaluation.

improver_modified.how: The best archived agent becomes the next self-editing meta-agent, so scaffold changes also change the improver.

limitations_evident: Evaluation repeatedly uses small fixed benchmark subsets
Fifteen iterations cost approximately $7000
Short timeouts amplify gains from faster tooling

title: Mem0: Building Production-Ready AI Agents with Scalable Long-Term Memory
problem: Finite context and noisy long histories prevent consistent recall across multi-session conversations.
assumption_broken: Persistent conversational context should be selectively consolidated and revised instead of repeatedly passing the full history.
load_bearing_mechanism: An LLM selects add, update, delete, or no-op operations on salient facts, with a graph variant preserving entity relationships.
limitations_evident: Adversarial unanswerable questions excluded
Evaluation limited to conversational memory
Graph memory adds operational overhead

title: Absolute Zero: Reinforced Self-play Reasoning with Zero Data
problem: Verifiable-reward reasoning training still depends on scarce human-curated question-answer distributions.
assumption_broken: A model can learn both its own training-task distribution and solutions without external task data.
load_bearing_mechanism: One jointly trained proposer-solver uses execution-grounded correctness and intermediate-difficulty rewards to evolve its curriculum.

improver_modified.how: Reinforcement learning updates the shared model in both task-proposal and task-solving roles.

limitations_evident: Gains depend on initial model capability
Environment limited to executable code tasks
Learning-progress reward is a proxy based on solver success

title: Self-Evolving Curriculum for LLM Reasoning
problem: Random, heuristic, or online-filtered training curricula are inefficient or poorly aligned with changing model capability.
assumption_broken: Training-category selection can learn concurrently with reasoning-model training instead of following a fixed curriculum.
load_bearing_mechanism: A non-stationary bandit uses absolute policy advantage as a cheap learning-gain proxy and updates category values with TD(0).

improver_modified.how: The curriculum-selection policy is updated online from the solver's training advantages.

limitations_evident: Requires predefined problem categories
Adds temperature and learning-rate tuning
Absolute advantage only approximates learning gain

title: MAS-ZERO: Designing Multi-Agent Systems with Zero Supervision
problem: Validation-tuned static multi-agent designs do not adapt decomposition or system complexity to individual problems.
assumption_broken: Multi-agent systems can be designed per instance without labeled validation data and can revert to simpler strategies.
load_bearing_mechanism: Meta-feedback on subtask solvability and completeness refines configurations while a verifier selects among evolved and simple-system answers.
limitations_evident: Weak meta-agents often generate invalid code
Context length limits evolution iterations
Verifier can accept errors grounded in retrieved search content

title: Get Experience from Practice: LLM Agents with Record & Replay
problem: Uncertain repeated LLM planning makes agent execution unreliable, costly, slow, and privacy sensitive.
assumption_broken: Agents can replay generalized checked experiences rather than regenerate every task plan from scratch.
load_bearing_mechanism: Multi-level reusable experiences pair flexible replay with trusted check functions enforcing workflow and safety constraints.
limitations_evident: Prototype focuses on bounded repetitive tasks
Experience levels and summaries lack precise definitions
Demonstration recording and check auditing burden users

title: metaTextGrad: Automatically optimizing language model optimizers
problem: Fixed human-designed LLM optimizers are poorly aligned with specific downstream tasks.
assumption_broken: Optimizer prompts and optimizer composition can themselves be optimized rather than held fixed.
load_bearing_mechanism: An outer loop refines optimizer prompts and compositions using the downstream performance of their inner-loop optimized programs.

improver_modified.how: Meta-optimization changes the prompts and composition of the inner optimizers.

limitations_evident: Meta-optimizer remains manually designed
Evaluation covers four narrow benchmark subsets
Outer-loop optimization adds model-call costs

title: SEW: Self-Evolving Agentic Workflows for Automated Code Generation
problem: Manually designed agent topologies and prompts limit adaptation to different coding problems.
assumption_broken: Both workflow structure and the mutation prompts used to improve agents can be evolved automatically.
load_bearing_mechanism: Joint workflow and agent-prompt evolution includes hyper-evolution that modifies mutation prompts before applying them.

improver_modified.how: Hyper-evolution rewrites the mutation prompts used to improve agent prompts.

limitations_evident: Generalization beyond coding is unknown
Some logically valid workflows cannot execute
Performance depends on backbone capabilities

title: Alita: Generalist Agent Enabling Scalable Agentic Reasoning with Minimal Predefinition and Maximal Self-Evolution
problem: Fixed handcrafted toolkits cannot cover the capabilities needed for diverse open-ended tasks.
assumption_broken: An agent can construct and integrate external capabilities on demand instead of relying on predefined tools.
load_bearing_mechanism: Execution-tested scripts and their environments are packaged as reusable MCP servers that expand the agent's available capabilities.
limitations_evident: Tool reuse is evaluated on the source benchmark
Smaller models struggle to generate useful tools
Two additional benchmarks use only 100 sampled questions each

title: Darwin Godel Machine: Open-Ended Evolution of Self-Improving Agents
problem: Fixed agent architectures and local improvement paths constrain autonomous progress in coding capabilities.
assumption_broken: Self-modifications can be justified empirically and suboptimal agents can remain useful evolutionary stepping stones.
load_bearing_mechanism: An open-ended archive lets self-modifying coding agents branch from diverse predecessors rather than requiring every change to improve immediately.

improver_modified.how: Archived coding agents rewrite their own implementation and subsequently perform further self-modifications; archive management remains fixed.

limitations_evident: Benchmark performance proxies self-improvement ability
Archive maintenance and parent selection remain fixed
Repeated subset evaluation risks benchmark overfitting

title: MermaidFlow: Redefining Agentic Workflow Generation via Safety-Constrained Evolutionary Programming
problem: Unconstrained workflow generation wastes search effort on fragile or unexecutable agent plans.
assumption_broken: Workflow search can operate on typed declarative graphs rather than directly editing implementation code.
load_bearing_mechanism: Type-compatible graph transformations constrain evolutionary search before workflows are translated into executable code.
limitations_evident: Static graph validity does not guarantee successful Python realization
Evaluation uses controlled reasoning benchmarks
Domain-specific node types bound the search space

title: From Knowledge to Noise: CTIM-Rover and the Pitfalls of Episodic Memory in Software Engineering Agents
problem: Software engineering agents discard repository knowledge and reusable insights after each task instance.
assumption_broken: Cross-instance episodic memory may be distracting rather than beneficial when transferred to complex software engineering tasks.
load_bearing_mechanism: General and repository-specific insights distilled from trajectories are injected alongside similar exemplars, but the reported effect is performance degradation from noisy memory.
limitations_evident: Environment setup failures exclude benchmark samples
Evaluation includes only 45 instances
Relevance-filtered memory retrieval is proposed but not tested

title: Tournament of Prompts: Evolving LLM Instructions Through Structured Debates and Elo Ratings
problem: Prompt optimization for subjective tasks lacks reliable predefined numerical fitness functions or labeled data.
assumption_broken: Pairwise model debates and relative ratings can guide prompt evolution without ground-truth fitness.
load_bearing_mechanism: Debate transcripts guide semantic crossover and mutation while Elo ratings and newcomer quotas select a diverse prompt population.
limitations_evident: Multi-round debate has substantial computational overhead
Implicit evaluation criteria may drift from user objectives
Robust stopping criteria are absent
